name: Rev
tagline: AI and human transcription, captions, and speech-to-text.
description: Transcription and captioning service offering fast AI transcription (~96% accuracy) plus on-demand human transcription at 99%+ accuracy, captions, and subtitles in dozens of languages. Adds AI note-taking and clip generation, and exposes its in-house ASR to developers via the Rev AI speech-to-text API.

modelSupport.notes: Uses Rev's own ASR models; human transcription handled by a transcriptionist marketplace.

edge: A rare two-tier choice: fast ~96% AI transcription or human transcription at 99%+ accuracy, plus captions and subtitles across 37+ languages.
cons: Human transcription costs add up per minute
Free tier is English-only and capped
AI accuracy trails human on hard audio
